records.text: New signup alert -- *Vantage Systems* just created a workspace on team.

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two Wrenfield emails (email:21151231, email:ea96ef06); no tickets filed, so no engagement signal. Team plan and active subscription suggest some intent, but silence plus an internal handoff (slack:16f21a20) makes self-serve activation in 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: A quick first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

I wanted to check in now that your Wrenfield account has been live a week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything about setting up your team on the Team plan.

Best,
Nadia
